h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Arrah

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Arrah

c: For a buyer in Arrah, the most useful question to ask any supplier is what happens after installation. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Arrah to schools, colleges, municipal parks and residential colonies in Bhojpur district, Bihar. We manufacture the Fun Fitness range at our Vasai factory, about 1,390 km away, and send it by road for installation by our team or a dealer in eastern India.

Our warranty is clear. Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry 3 years, and springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year, against manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions. At handover we explain the basic upkeep: keep the machines clean, check moving joints, and report problems early. Our after-sales team takes calls from Monday to Saturday. The Bhojpur plains get hot summers and a heavy monsoon, so a raised, drained base matters as much as the machines themselves.

items.q: What if a machine needs repair in Arrah?
items.a: Call our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or email aftersales@funplaysystems.com. Parts covered by warranty are handled as per our terms, and we can send spares by road.

items.q: Do you deliver outdoor gym equipment to Bihar?
items.a: Yes. We manufacture at our Vasai factory and send the full order by road. Our installation team or a dealer in eastern India fixes the machines on site.

items.q: How should we prepare the ground before the monsoon?
items.a: Raise the gym area slightly and give it a slope for drainage. We tell you whether each machine is grouted or self-standing so the base can be prepared in advance.
